method: Actual local GLB JSON/BIN+SHA256; existing GLTFLoader and lab loaded-asset validation; all vertices of required9 farm clips at 24fps plus endpoints, independently evaluated CPU skinning cross-checked against Three.js on first vertex of every mesh/frame. No source file mutations.

historicalInspectionSubset.status: Historical inspection only; not the selected production expansion or permission to replace corresponding existing appearances.

limitations: No browser, CUA, GPU, hardware FPS, screenshot, gameplay or visual-art evidence.
Lab donor manifest status remains prototype. This report is not production admission.
Generated author contacts/metrics/blend sources are absent in this checkout; full validate-animation-lab main cannot be rerun and would mutate preexisting metadata.
Required9 clips were CPU sampled; extra clips were structurally validated but not animated in this audit.
Ground support phases, gait sliding, semantic anatomy/art quality, gameplay pond contact, carry positioning, persistence, resource-provider gates and interaction behavior remain runtime/visual work.
Compression byte counts are actual in-memory lossless transport encodings, not deployed asset changes or verified server Content-Encoding.
Full-clip bounds shown as claimed are preexisting index metadata, separately checked against loaded rest pose by the existing loader. Required9 sampled bounds are fresh measurements.
